classification.reason: The customer is only asking to confirm how the annual discount works (not requesting a refund or discretionary discount), and billing_faq.md clearly states annual billing gives a 20% discount versus monthly.

draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out, and glad to clarify this for you.

Yes, that's the same discount. For the Team plan, annual billing is $12/user/month (billed as one upfront annual charge), compared to $15/user/month when billed monthly -- that works out to the 20% discount for choosing annual billing. Being charged the full annual amount up front is expected behavior for that billing cycle: charges occur on the day you upgrade, then annually on that same calendar day going forward.

You can always double-check the breakdown for your workspace under Settings > Billing > Invoices, where each charge is itemized.

Let me know if you have any other questions.

Best,
Loopwise Support
